The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 52c828f91521d93c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Keep C, n, d, L as in the preceding corollary. Put Γ = Pic0 (C)[n], let γ ∈ Γ have order m, and let κ ∈ b Γ be the character κ(γ′) = ⟨γ, γ′⟩Γ defined by the Weil pairing in [MS21, Section 1.3]. Let π : C′ → C be the associated cyclic étale cover, set r = n/m, and put dγ = codimAKC AKC γ , where AKC γ is their endoscopic Hitchin base. For D = KC and D′ = π∗KC = KC′ , let pB κ denote their nonabelian-Hodge-transported operator in [MS21, Section 5.4]. Write f MB r,d(C′) for the full degree-d twisted GLr character variety and MB n,L(C) = XB for the fixed-determinant twisted SLn character variety. On complexified cohomology, for all integers i, k ≥ 0, pB κ  W2kHi ( f MB r,d(C′ ), C)  = W2k+2dγ Hi+2dγ (MB n,L(C), C)κ, where the subscript κ denotes the pullback-action summand on which γ′∗α = κ(γ′)α for every γ′ ∈ Γ.
